summary: Introduces resource reporting, which gives visibility into external resources that modules touch but aren't in inventory, implemented as a YAML query file using jq expressions to map module return values to a standard taxonomy.
questions: How can I report which cloud resources my modules touched even if they're not in inventory?
What is resource reporting in an Ansible collection?
How does a collection expose resource metadata?

answer_card.title: What resource reporting is
answer_card.answer_md: Resource reporting gives structured visibility into resources your modules manage, even those not in inventory (cloud, hypervisor, network controllers). Add a lightweight **YAML query file** to the collection; each entry uses a **jq expression** to map module return values into a standardized resource taxonomy.
